checklists.summary: Generate Wiki batch scan now creates a separate card for every named spell/feature/ability/item plus an overview card linking to them, and links new cards to existing ones via buildCardIndex (cross-scan linking). Profiles gain a homeCardId pinned at the top of the Library.

items.text: Scan a class page with several named features via Generate Wiki → each named feature/spell becomes its own card, not one lumped card
An overview card for the parent subject links to the sub-cards with tappable gold terms
Run a second Generate Wiki scan in the same profile → new cards link to cards from the first scan instead of duplicating them
Open a profile → set Home / Index Card to one of its cards → that card appears pinned at the top of the Library with a ⌂ marker
The pinned home card does not also appear in the normal list below
Set Home / Index Card back to None → pinned card returns to the normal list

checklists.summary: Migrated profiles from sections/scanInstructions model to fields/additionalInstructions. ProfileEditor now shows a label-only field editor with ▲/▼ reorder and delete. api.js buildPrompt uses field labels.
checklists.deviations: Drag-to-reorder replaced with ▲/▼ buttons. key auto-derived from label. Fields carry no explicit type — Claude infers text vs key-value from context.

items.text: Open the D&D 5e profile → fields show (Name, Level, etc.) not old sections
Add a new field, reorder with ▲/▼, delete one → changes save
Type in Additional Instructions → assembled prompt preview updates live
Toggle "Use custom prompt" on → freeform textarea appears, assembled preview hidden
Toggle it back off → fields and instructions still intact
Scan a card using the edited profile → card comes back with expected fields

checklists.summary: New QA tab in the main nav. Reads checklists from qa-checklists.json, persists check/note state in IndexedDB qaState table. Supports per-item notes, general notes, clipboard export, and reset with confirmation.

items.text: QA tab appears in the nav bar with a clipboard/checkmark icon
Profile Editing checklist card shows with feature name, date, and "0/6 checked" progress
Tap checklist card → expands to show all items with checkboxes
Check off an item → progress updates, state persists after closing and reopening the tab
Tap note icon on an item → textarea expands below, type a note → saves
Type in General Notes textarea → saves
Tap "Export Report" → markdown copied to clipboard (paste somewhere to verify format)
Tap "Reset Checklist" → confirmation dialog → clears all checks and notes
